title: Friend Requests I: Overall Acceptance Rate
goal: Compute the overall acceptance rate using distinct directed request and acceptance pairs.
strategy: Repeated records for the same sender and receiver count once, regardless of date. Divide distinct accepted pairs by distinct requested pairs, round to two decimals, and return zero if there are no requests.

edgeCases: No requests yields zero instead of division by zero

One accepted pair out of three requires decimal rounding
